# Aria Everyday Activities

Wearable multisensory daily-life recordings used for behavior anticipation in EgoAdapt.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Recent egocentric sensor observations from everyday activities.

**Output / label:** Future gaze, head orientation and motion trajectory; these are behavioral measurements, not semantic intention labels.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://huggingface.co/datasets/projectaria/aria-everyday-activities)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://huggingface.co/datasets/projectaria/aria-everyday-activities), [anticipation_paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21080)

## Intention in this dataset

Future behavioral measurements in the cited EgoAdapt setup are proxies for behavior anticipation; the original collection has no verified semantic intention target.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2024

**Domains:** daily_activities, social_interaction  
**Intention types:** action  
**Tasks:** behavior_prediction, trajectory_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, audio, gaze, imu, trajectory, text, pose  
**Formats:** video, time_series, text, structured_annotation
